name: Hamish Te Kanawa
bio:
Hamish's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A qualified engineer with a background in aviation maintenance, he stumbled upon a local rally event and was immediately captivated by the intricate mechanics and relentless pursuit of performance. Dissatisfied with the rigid structures of the aviation industry, he transitioned into motorsport, drawn by the dynamic challenges and constant innovation.

At United Autosports, Hamish's meticulous eye for detail and unwavering commitment to quality have made him an invaluable asset to the team. He firmly believes that a robust quality control process is not merely about identifying flaws but about fostering a culture of excellence. His ability to balance rigorous standards with a pragmatic approach ensures that the team's equipment is always performing at its peak.

What sets Hamish apart is his uncanny ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues simply by listening to the engine. This 'ear for trouble,' honed over years of experience, has saved the team countless hours in troubleshooting and prevented potential disasters on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A sturdy man with a calm, observant demeanor and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his chin when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating his own tools before any critical task.
